description: S51 T2 (TM5), the named nothing: triage.history of an id with no bug row refuses with ErrTriageUnknown — an EMPTY history belongs to a bug that exists and has no rows, and collapsing the two would let a typo'd id read as a pristine bug (and a bug's audit read say 'clean' about a row nobody ever filed). The refusal quotes the id it looked for; nothing was read, nothing was written. triage.update answers the same fact through the door's ordinary refusal.

error.message: the triage read named no bug

data.means: nothing was read about a nonexistent bug — an EMPTY history is a real bug with no rows; this is a different fact, which is why it is a different error
